about: The deletion residual window, stated as numbers (foundation/08, decision 017). backup_retention_days bounds how long any backup of the payload plane may exist, db/backup.mjs enforces it by refusing to keep older dumps, and purge_interval_days is the stated schedule on which shredded rows are physically removed (core/deletion, `deletion purge`). These numbers ARE the disclosure: the worker-facing deletion copy (copy/deletion.md) states them in prose, and checks/deletion-copy.mjs fails the build when the copy and this file drift. Changing a number here is changing a promise made to workers, so the check forces the copy to move in the same commit. confirmation_window_days is the cancellable window between filing a deletion request and the irreversible shred (decision 052); access cuts immediately on filing.
